articles.title: U.S. senators urge Treasury not to leave states out of GENIUS Act stablecoin process
articles.snippet: Senators led by Republican Cynthia Lummis are insisting the Treasury Department ensure states get a process to prove their ability to supervise stablecoins.

articles.title: Ripple invests in Flutterwave, pushing its stablecoin and XRP Ledger into payments across Africa
articles.snippet: The deal values Flutterwave at $3.2 billion, and will integrate Ripple's RLUSD and the XRP Ledger network to speed cross-border payments across Africa.

articles.title: State Street targets stablecoin reserve boom with new money market fund
articles.snippet: The asset manager joins BlackRock, Franklin Templeton and others competing to manage reserves backing the growing stablecoin market.

articles.title: State Street launches GENIUS Act-aligned money market fund for stablecoin reserves
articles.snippet: The launch comes amid growing competition among financial institutions to manage assets backing dollar-pegged stablecoins.

articles.title: Trump crypto company's USD1 stablecoins backing UFC event bonuses
articles.snippet: A spokesperson for the Democratic National Committee decried the move as “an opportunity to use the power of the presidency to make [Trump] and his family even richer.”
